as_told.title: T. Townsend Brown had visitors land in Zanesville

plain: Townsend Brown was an American inventor of the mid twentieth century, and this story says that small beings used to land in his yard and give him information. A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he has had his own encounters with strange beings, says he heard this from a man named Timothy Taylor. Bledsoe says that when they met in Zanesville, Taylor explained he was helping Brown's daughter finish a book about her father, and told him about Brown having visitors who came and landed. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, adds that Brown's daughter, Linda Brown, did an online question and answer session on the website Reddit. Michels says she talked there about pale beings coming down and entering the house, into the kitchen. If true, an inventor's ideas may have come from visitors who were not human.
